scenes.name: Perch
scenes.desc: The currawong glances left, calls out, and turns to face right

scenes.name: Launch
scenes.desc: It crouches, opens its wings and leaps off the ledge, shedding feathers

scenes.name: Swoop
scenes.desc: It flies back in low, the wordmark appearing in its wake, and lands on the G

scenes.name: Lockup
scenes.desc: Perched on the wordmark, it blinks, looks back over the word and calls; the personal mark forms underneath
